subject: Geography

description: Investigate the 2021 Ahr valley flood with a map, photos, and a timeline, and weigh how river engineering affects flood risk.

subject: History
title: Printing press and industrialisation
description: Explore two timelines and compare how printing and industrialisation changed work, knowledge, and everyday life.

description: Train an image classifier, cluster data, and watch an agent learn safe routes to meet three kinds of machine learning.

description: Use NASA data, a periodic table, and a molecule builder to connect electronegativity with the ozone hole.

description: Listen to recorded examples, then write down intervals and rhythms in interactive music scores.

subject: Biology
title: Eat and be eaten?
description: Follow an apple tree, caterpillars, a tit, and a cat through a garden food chain, then order the chain yourself.

title: Can water ease heartburn?
description: Mix stomach acid, water, and baking soda in a virtual lab and build the molecules to explain what neutralises acid.
